comments.body:
🟡 **False Cmd reviews for quoted filenames** After a quoted `cmd /c` command, `cmd_payload` can mistake a quoted output filename’s closing quote for the payload’s closing quote. A filename such as `capture (sales & support).txt` then triggers an unmatched-parenthesis review instead of honoring existing approval.
Learn more A redirection outside a quoted `cmd /c` payload belongs to the outer Cmd. [cmd_redirect](https://github.com/gosuda/charamel/blob/c00962f26db32a41cfc1c487027a8b6316cb8bf1/bin/crush/lib/shell_screen.ml#L1796-L1805 "bin/crush/lib/shell_screen.ml:1796-1805") marks its filename as a redirection target, and [end_cmd_word](https://github.com/gosuda/charamel/blob/c00962f26db32a41cfc1c487027a8b6316cb8bf1/bin/crush/lib/shell_screen.ml#L1774-L1791 "bin/crush/lib/shell_screen.ml:1774-1791") leaves that target out of the argument list. The raw source slice puts it back into the nested payload. [cmd_payload](https://github.com/gosuda/charamel/blob/c00962f26db32a41cfc1c487027a8b6316cb8bf1/bin/crush/lib/shell_screen.ml#L1907-L1924 "bin/crush/lib/shell_screen.ml:1907-1924") removes the first and last quotes, leaving the filename unquoted on the second parse. The shell tool sends that parse failure through its [explicit review path](https://github.com/gosuda/charamel/blob/c00962f26db32a41cfc1c487027a8b6316cb8bf1/bin/crush/lib/tools_shell.ml#L254-L260 "bin/crush/lib/tools_shell.ml:254-260"). **Example:** `cmd /d /c "echo ready" > "capture (sales & support).txt"` redirects output from a valid command. The nested screen instead sees `echo ready" > "capture (sales & support).txt`. It treats `&` as a command separator and reports the filename’s closing parenthesis as unmatched. **Recommended fix:** Track outer redirection spans while scanning the segment and exclude them when assembling the nested payload. Preserve the original separators and leave redirections inside the quoted payload intact. Add a classifier test for a quoted payload followed by a quoted filename containing both `&` and parentheses.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🔍 **Payload preservation lacks a regression check** `screen_table` expects `Clear` for both `echo key=value` and `echo key value`, so either payload passes. [test_cmd_echo_permissions](https://github.com/gosuda/charamel/blob/c00962f26db32a41cfc1c487027a8b6316cb8bf1/test/crush/test_tools_shell.ml#L799-L823 "test/crush/test_tools_shell.ml:799-823") checks exit status but never asserts which text the command printed. --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*
